shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50 && cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cat app/lib/auth.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "forbidden" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20 && (npx next start -p 3456 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/admin && grep -o '403\|Access denied\|noindex' /tmp/admin.html | sort -u; pkill -f "next start" ; true

cd /workspace && npx next build 2>&1 | grep -A6 'Route (app)'; (npx next start -p 3456 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "admin: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/admin; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/; grep -c 'Access denied' /tmp/admin.html; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short
cd /workspace && git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json
cat .gitignore; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short
